name: Ambrose Hazen: Enlisted
description: Lynch claims to want to end Corruption, but Ambrose no longer trusts her intentions. When Otis asks him to join up with a renegade army unit instead, he lends his gun. Maybe the cure is more firepower: for Corruption and Ambrose’s racing thoughts.
source: The Regiment's Last Stand Story Challenge

name: Ambrose Hazen: Officer
description: Ambrose didn’t much enjoy his time as a military man, but he’s decided he looks good in the uniform. It reminds him of how much he values his freedom after the 26th Regiment’s final siege. Now he searches for mental liberation to match.
source: The Regiment's Last Stand Story Challenge

name: Ambrose Hazen: Rookie
description: A woman in a hooded cloak once beckoned to Ambrose Hazen from atop the lighthouse outside of Iron Works, promising riches in return for favors. He agreed, leaving her strange packages in stranges places–like inside a dead Hives’ ribcage. But what was inside them?

name: Ambrose Hazen: Survivor
description: Ambrose Hazen enjoyed the rewards he reaped from the cloaked woman too much to look inside one of her strange packages. Eventually, though, his curiosity won when he heard a scratching sound inside one of the boxes. When he looked inside, he wished he hadn’t.

name: Ambrose Hazen: Veteran
description: People take bets about what unholy thing awaited Ambrose Hazen in the box he never should have opened. His story always changes, but some say that if you utter the name “ Lynch ” in his presence, he won’t hesitate to kill you.

name: Angel of Death
description: Born in the darkness of the same sunken crypt where she was once buried alive, Angel of Death paints the bayou with blood that’s black as ink in the moonlight. Is she a specter? A murderer? Death itself? Perhaps it’s best to count no option out.
source: The Ghost of Blanchett Graves DLC

name: Antonia Higuera: Rookie
description: Antonia Higuera learned quickly that supplies could make or break a Hunt. She collected contraband equipment religiously, intent on setting herself up for success. When she heard word of places with more riches than the corpses she looted could ever hold, she set off.

name: Antonia Higuera: Survivor
description: Between the abandoned train cars and hidden rooms packed with ammo and dynamite, Antonia Higuera was never caught unprepared. Still, she knew that special loot existed which could offer a Hunter more than basic supplies ever could, and so her search continued.

name: Antonia Higuera: Veteran
description: Antonia Higuera knows that she can find impossible advantages–miraculous healings, abilities not of our world–within the circles of abandoned wagons and the rarest supply points. She also knows that overeager Hunters often let their guards down in such places, making for easy kills.

name: Bad Hand
description: Bad at faro and worse at poker, John Robertson was determined to find glory and gold at a card table. But he was fated to become the Revenant, and he lived as he died - making the best of a bad hand.

name: Biatatá
description: Like the legends of Biatatá, Beatriz Ribeiro Valente was a creature of fire trapped underwater. From the beaches of Salvador to the damps of the Bayou, she learned her flames could not be quenched. With nowhere to belong, she rose to set the world ablaze.
source: Biatatá - Still Waters Run Deep DLC

name: Billy Story
description: Few who encountered this New Orleans “gentleman" would ever forget him – be it for his strange and extravagant dress, his raucous sense of humor, or the content of his infamous Blue Books.

name: Bloody Red: Hood
description: Emilia Montgomery was a naive little girl before she met the wolf in the woods. After she killed and skinned him, her blood turned ice-cold. Now she carries out her new mission to punish all things big and bad.

name: Bloody Red: Wolf
description: From high forests to foggy swamps, Emilia Montgomery hunts ruthlessly with a trickster's cunning and a wolf's bite. The tale of her grisly origin speaks for itself when she wears the head of her cruelest nemesis–a warning to all. Hunters: Beware.

name: Bruja: Crone
description: An experienced healer of body and soul, when Ygnacia Cruz Gutierrez isn’t fighting the Corruption herself, she’s saving wounded Hunters. Though her allies call her kind, and she does dote on her apprenticed granddaughter , the unworthy don’t live long under her care.
source: 900 Blood Bonds / Garden of the Witch Event

name: Bruja: Maiden
description: Librada Cruz Mendoza wants to nurture those who work for what’s good in the world–and punish those who don’t. Though some ungrateful Hunters feel entitled to her healings, Librada ensures everyone she treats gets their just desserts, just like her grandmother before her.
source: 900 Blood Bonds / Garden of the Witch Event

name: Burnt Marshall
description: A comet fell from the sky. The Great Peshtigo Fire raged in its wake, and a boy watched bodies burn in unnatural wildfire. He grew, learned flame’s language – catalogued its desire for forests and flesh. Now he seeks the strange Inferno raging in the south.

name: Butcher's Cleaver
description: Reginald Villemont dropped to all fours when hunting feral swine, sniffing scat, and divining runes and mysticisms from tracks. He flayed wild pig throats with his teeth as he delved deeper into the bayou, finding a source of salvation and obliteration alike: the Butcher.

name: Cain
description: Primal in his fury and sparse with his words, his name oft falling from the lips of those facing death. Cain's sacrifices mount high as he rattles through the godless bayou, burdened by the bones of his grief.

name: Caitlyn Hammond
description: Hammond was the black sheep of her family. She rebelled against expectations of her becoming a schoolmarm, and instead focused on wilder pursuits. Finally cast out for her refusal to conform, she took her guns and her independence south to Louisiana and the Hunt.

name: Captain Laffite
description: Filth roils alive and precious inside Captain Laffite. His arteries have transformed into marsh ways and canals for a kind of life only drowned captains can know. He inhales curses. Spits out gunpowder smoke. When a ship sinks, he’s there to guide it home.

name: Carcass Gunrunner
description: Butcher, clandestine arms dealer, and hobby apothecarist, Jason Trevors is known for being coldly logical and just unhinged enough that his opponents never know what to expect. A vital asset to the Hunter cause, Trevors could import any firearm from the world over without import tax, provided it fit into a carcass.

name: Cardinal Rain
description: Rains and reptiles marched west, flooding and trampling villages. Chasing them were flashes of red feathers and dauntless arms that buckled the will of the fiercest alligators. Cardinal Rain tracked the rot guiding the beasts and seeks to strangle it at the source.

name: Carter
description: William Carter was a sharpshooter, and the inventor of many a curious new attraction for the Wild West Shows he starred in. Ever the showman, he fictionalized most of his life story, and though no one knows his true origins two things are clear: he’s a fearsome shot with an extravagant sense of humor – and adventure.

name: Chum
description: Raised in the circus to be nothing more than a source of simple amusement, Chum rose to prominence under the tutelage of the HelioStone. He has become its chosen vessel, issuing its commands and doing its will through acts of violence, power, and terror.

name: Coal Bearer
description: The bayou sky shifted, and the North Pole’s shifted to match. Ashen snow heralded the Coal Bearer’s journey southward, for heavy is the head that wears the crown, but heavier is the sack on the back of the man who judges good from bad.

name: Commander Whitlaw
description: Whitlaw formed the renegade 26th Regiment after he was denied official permission to seek his missing scouts. After the horrors of his mission made him paranoid, only a gun could steady his shaking hands against enemies–or allies.

name: Corvid: Bile
description: The Corruption is an empiric’s dream, and Maxwell Creed works alongside his fellow experimenter to cut the tongues from enemy Hunters, hoping to absorb whispers of their secrets. After all, what better way is there to understand a disease than to become a part of it?

name: Corvid: Brood
description: She sacrificed her morals dissecting the bubonic heart of infection, losing herself in the madness and blight – blood knows her name, and she knows its taste. Now, Emma Davies joins an old colleague in the Hunt to conduct the ghoulish, Corrupted experiments of her dreams.

name: Crossroads Walker
description: Trained in the ways of voodoo from a young age, Jeremiah Scruggs grew up restless and hungry for success. Using sleight of hand and party tricks as a performer, he concealed his true knowledge—and intentions.

name: Dame of the Dead
description: Antonia returned from work to find her home and family burned alive — but one body was missing. On the Day of the Dead, an ominous clue on the ofrenda spurred her to follow her sister Sofia into the brackish veil between life and death.

name: Daughter of Decay
description: As a child, Maeve Flynn buried her family, and from their rotten flesh grew the crops that allowed her to grow vigorous and sturdy. Honoring their sacrifice, she vowed to appease the corrupted soil with blood, be it her enemies' or her own.

name: Dead Blessing
description: Though she does not speak of her past, her name speaks volumes of both her talents - and her fate. Though her journey to America with Zhong Kui was made the more perilous by bans on Chinese immigration, Louisiana Hunters were grateful for the duo's arrival, if not also intimidated in the field.

name: Death Mask
description: Former lawman Joshua Merkley fell to the Corruption - until the Corvids found his shambling body. He awoke in agony, but could grasp a gun again. Trapped between life and death, he captures grunts for more experiments and seeks a truer cure.

name: Deckhand
description: Of all the terrible things to wash up in the bayou, Frank Glib was one of the worst. A teller of sailors' yarns, oft not to be believed, it soon became clear that he truly was no stranger to bloodshed, that his life on the water had overflown with death, and there was a reason he had outlived many crews.

name: Desert Rose: Blue Skies
description: Taught by her pa to shoot, Mercy Scribner ran away to join The Murder Circus. But when the HelioStone arrived, she fled, taking her deadeye talents elsewhere. Years later, Post Malone found her and told her what had happened. Now she stalks The Murder Circus with a clear eye and a vengeful heart.

name: Desert Rose: Dust Devil
description: Even the most beautiful flower needs to be hard-edged to survive in the desert. Mercy Scribner’s no exception. As tough as the land she grew up in, she lets her guns do the talking when situations get uncouth, and never has to repeat herself.

name: The Statesman: Desolation's Delegate
description: Desolation’s Delegate survived his last encounter with Hunters, when he was called The Statesman, to acclaim from many interested and influential donors. To keep the money flowing, he sets out again to see if any trace remains of the Land of the Dead.

name: Devil's Advocate
description: Henry Trapp is a good man at a cost: When the bad in him builds up, he dons the devil's mask to release his dark urges. All turned a blind eye because of the good Henry did, but when the Hunt began, for the sake of the innocent, they sent him to it.

name: Dire Wolf
description: Remus Frisk never thought twice when killing packs of wolves, and he never paid a price for those massacres - until he came to the Bayou to hunt his last wolf - and this time, it was one from his own pack.

name: Disciple of Death
description: The infamous former Ringmaster has spent the past year underground, fighting shoulder-to-shoulder with seasoned Hunters and becoming more legendary than ever–though few know his true identity. If the Corrupted Circus returns, he intends to destroy it.
source: Post Malone's Murder Circus Encore Event

name: Dorothy Alice: Dream
description: Dorothy’s upbringing was idyllic but humble. She treasured her novels, and moreover, her family. When they succumbed to Corruption, those adventurous stories had prepared her. She carried her family’s mementos and dared others to join her for a tea party at home, on Alice Farm .

name: Dorothy Alice: Nightmare
description: Dorothy’s dream was ended by The Fool , her bright imagination was twisted into darkness. Now, she prowls the bayou like a demon hunting an exorcist. Her last remaining heirloom? A derringer with a bullet for when the nightmare needs to end.

name: False Saint
description: Kevin Linus endured pain after unimaginable pain for the sake of The Moon and Louisiana. He fought with all his being, thinking death would be his final reward. But fate had a greater plan, and a greater calling.

name: Felis
description: Accomplices to the devil, stealers of souls, and ill omens, cats have long been associated with dark magic. Nika Felis bears the skull of one feline adversary on her head as a warning to others that she has capabilities as powerful – and as dangerous. Rumored to be a shapeshifter, and a colleague of Doctor John .

name: Gar
description: Maux nearly drowned in the storm of '93. Beneath the inland whitecaps, the saber snouts of gar fish kissed her, showed her visions of reptile birthing pits and extinct rituals. Reborn, Gar carries the will of those many teeth onto land.

name: Ghost Face
description: No one can recall Nehemiah Hexum's face before he put the mask on. However, Hunters know the faces of his victims all too well. In each twisted and open mouth, they can hear the echo of the cry that once lived there.

name: Giggles
description: The brains behind The Murder Circus, Giggles steers the operation through the Land of the Dead to reach its new destinations. Wickedly smart and patient, she is far more deadly than she appears.

name: Grotesque: Gouge
description: Freed from his prison after a decade, James Master still could not remove his restraints–nor did he wish to. Rotten scraps of flesh were his diet for a decade, so he hunted to satisfy that appetite for death and decay.

name: Grotesque: Shank
description: Framed for a murder too gruesome to describe in print, James Master was chained in a pit until he forgot the crime. Eventually, he even forgot that he was innocent. Felis pulled him out of that pit, setting a lunatic loose on the Corruption.

name: Hail Mary
description: In Holy Communion, Mary Burgess had her first taste of blood. In defense of her convent, her second. And in the Bayou, her third, where she - disgraced and excommunicated - dedicated her righteous fury to spilling the unholy blood of the corrupted, in hopes of fighting her way back to the light.

name: Harvest: Day
description: Born from the seed of autumn’s taste for darkness, Harvest rises from wormy fields of rotten gourds to feast on daylight. His hunger for souls is insatiable, and his penchant for suffering marks the coming of a most dreadful season of reaping.

name: Harvest: Dusk
description: As pumpkins are smashed and blood spills upon soil, Harvest brings about a killing dusk. Hauntings burden the minds of troubled Hunters. They shoot and slit and stab and set fires while whispering in tongues. Each ghost they harvest digs his roots deeper.

name: Harvest: Midnight
description: Midnight descends upon every Hunter as a castle of rotting tendrils and pulsing pits of pumpkin guts. All who resist his season are blinded by an orange, fuming moon. The light from their souls glows helplessly as October’s great carved mouth swallows them whole.

name: Hawkshaw Jack
description: Feared by outlaws and lawmen alike in New York, Jack Marwick considered corruption a tool when solving mysteries. He came to Louisiana to put his skills to work but discovered a new kind of corruption even he cannot exploit.

name: Hayalî
description: Hayalî can be persuaded, on occasion, to spin stories out of light and darkness. These plays feature two men of opposing temperaments: one canny and the other haughty. Hayalî is a master of opposing forces, hunting by enchanting then punishing, puppeteering his foes to their final act.

name: Head Taker
description: There’s no irony behind Head Taker’s title. Just a trail of graves a foot too short, and the testimony of sheriffs disturbed by the proof used to claim their bounties. Only one has survived his pursuit: a Turncoat traipsing the same sun-bleached meridian. Survived, so far.

name: Hex Breaker
description: Answering a call from the last Elias, a man of many names emerges from crimson shadows. He too has faced Corruptions and covens older than mankind. New Orleans has been reckless in containing the outbreak, but he will end Corruption’s spread.

name: Iron Bark
description: Orphaned by winter, Iron Bark was raised by wolves as one of their own. But the pack moved on, and with an unending winter came a shortage of food, warmth, and hope. So Iron Bark sacrificed their old family to claim all three.

name: Ironshod Bandit
description: Clever and quick, the lronshod Bandit escaped indentured servitude on a stolen horse and now swears to serve himself. Between contracts, he can be found playing mahjong, but few get close enough to realize that even his games might be part of grander schemes.

name: Jane Eddings: Rookie
description: Jane Eddings couldn’t ignore the magnetic intrigue she felt upon spotting the legendary Corvid Hunters for the first time, with their pointed beaks and cold, threatening auras. She found new purpose in tracking them, wanting to discover for herself what was behind their masks.

name: Jane Eddings: Survivor
description: When Jane Eddings came across an abandoned camp littered with cracked beakers and rusted scalpels, she knew that her confrontation with the Corvids was imminent at least. Would they yield to her request willingly? Or would she have to remove their masks herself?

name: Jane Eddings: Veteran
description: Jane Eddings has learned that speaking isn’t all that necessary while hunting. In the dead of quieter nights, she wonders if her stolen tongue is still rotting away inside the beak of Brood and Bile’s mask, filing their lungs with her essence.

name: Jesse Buchanan: Rookie
description: Jesse Buchanan has always been a leader, naturally inclined to clean up on the Hunt due to the skills he developed in the army. When a former brother-in-arms, Delacroix , went missing in Colorado after speaking with Wyatt Preston, Jesse swore to find him.

name: Jesse Buchanan: Survivor
description: The search for his missing army brother led Jesse Buchanan to Kingfisher Foundry in Mammon’s Gulch. Evidence pointed toward a long-abandoned bore shaft, that felt, for lack of a better term, haunted. What he found within the oil-slicked passage changed Jesse forever.

name: Jesse Buchanan: Veteran
description: Jesse Buchanan lost hope of ever seeing Delacroix again. Between cashing in bounties, he spies on wandering Hellborn from the concealment of bushes and scopes. He can’t help but wonder if his brother-in-arms is still in there somewhere, forever changed within the flames.

name: Joan Damon: Rookie
description: Joan Damon got married at First Testimonial Church in DeSalle and had a celebration at Seven Sisters Estate , right before the infection hit. At the reception, wedding guests transformed and started tearing each other apart. Her husband Ralph was killed in the pandemonium.

name: Joan Damon: Survivor
description: Heartbroken over the loss of her beloved Ralph and most of her family, Joan Damon wandered the infected pockets of Louisiana, intent on inflicting her anger on every last inch of Corruption. Through the endless killings, she knew only grief.

name: Joan Damon: Tracker
description: By now, everyone knows Joan Damon as a woman who always catches her quarry, not matter how fast they run. But tracking down murderer Leon Ulitsky showed her she’ll never catch what she needs herself. It’s already far behind her.

name: Joan Damon: Veteran
description: Joan Damon is a Hunter as shaped by the horrors of the Incursion as any other. Still, every gunfight or confrontation against the Corruption’s monsters is fueled by something special. “For Ralph”, she thinks every time, knowing how proud he’d be of her grit.

name: John Victor
description: An experienced Hunter with a soft spot for newcomers, Victor is always willing to take some time to train rookies on the Hunt. Maybe its because someone else took him under their wing when he first came to the bayou.

name: Justin Pierce
description: An eccentric weaver of words with a taste for the strange, Justin Pierce became a Hunter to gather stories worthy of the fiction he secretly writes under the pen name Hellstrom. Ulterior motives aside, his gunslinging skills are just as sharp as his pen.

name: Kendoka
description: Kendoka survived decades of shobu death matches, where each victory stained his record ever more red. His skill earned him the role of bodyguard for a cruel warlord. When opportunity arose, Kendoka impaled him on a bamboo shinai and fled with his trove of weaponry.

name: Kill Buyer
description: Kenneth Jupe's love for horses turned into a morbid obsession as he dissected his beloved Butterscotch in fascination. When there was nothing left of her, and no money for another, Jupe ran to the bayou where he could dismember to his heart's desire.

name: Krampus
description: Winter is a time for reflection and reckoning. The good have nothing to worry about. The naughty have Krampus, the midwinter trickster doling out devilish punishments to right the year’s wrongs. Amongst the Hunters, there are few who do not worry.
source: On the Winds of Midwinter Story Challenge

name: Lady Lewis
description: More than anything, Lady Lewis yearns to return Lower DeSalle to its former glory, even if only for the benefit of Hunters. Her reputation as Lewis' most beloved entertainer makes her the perfect person for the job, but the hidden truth behind the saloon's Corruption may ruin everything.
source: The Heart of Lower DeSalle DLC

name: Laura Gottschalk: Rookie
description: Before taking the inoculation, Laura Gottschalk was a leader, not a follower. But after beholding the Sculptor’s most twisted creations, she searched for answers beyond explanation in the most unexpected place: Isaac Powell and his Night of the Hunter cult.

name: Laura Gottschalk: Survivor
description: The apocalyptic visions she endured as a heralded member of a supernatural cult changed everything about who Laura Gottschalk was. Gone where the days of cowering in the shadows of the truth, replaced by a nihilistic arrogance that made even her closest comrades-in-doom nervous.

name: Laura Gottschalk: Veteran
description: Banished from her newfound family for trying to usurp its leader, Laura Gottschalk continues to nurture the seed of violence that was savagely planted in her heart by the cult’s visions. When doomsday arrives and she’s proven right, they’ll beg for mercy at her feet.

name: Leo Nuñez
description: Leo Nuñez hunts against his will, held by the curse rooted in the items on his belt. Who put them there or how he got into this conundrum is something he keeps a secret, but he fights as though his soul depends on it.

name: Leon Ulitsky: Eluder
description: To stay alive, Leon Ulitsky became the stealthiest man on a wanted poster. But once he was finally caught, his tracker didn’t pull the trigger. Leon knew it wasn’t because he was a good man, but because others were far worse.

name: Leon Ulitsky: Rookie
description: Always one to appreciate the safety of hunting in numbers, Leon Ultisky fell in with a group of bandits who made their own rules. When the group set their sights on a new set of rewards, he found himself leaving the bayou for the gulch.

name: Leon Ulitsky: Survivor
description: Holding up the supply trains that ran in and out of Incursion zones became second nature for Leon Ulitsky. He and his cohorts were able to make money without having to face blood-chilling monsters. One day, though, they robbed the wrong damn train.

name: Leon Ulitsky: Veteran
description: Leon Ulitsky no longer holds up supply trains, forever changed after becoming the only survivor of his group. It was a gunfight against none other than Sheriff Hardin himself that taught Leon the ultimate lesson: Sometimes, the Hunters are worse than the monsters.

name: Lilith
description: Escaped from a murderous cult and granted a second chance at life by the Pale Judge , Lilith doesn’t use her weapons for justice. She uses them to blow open cage doors to freedom and clear a path for revenge.
source: Cry of the Caged Bird DLC

name: Llorona's Heir
description: Much like the legend whose name she uses, Llorona earned her fearsome reputation by drowning her victims and haunting her enemies. Like a shade, she is fast and subtle, with both gun and knife.

name: Lonely Howl
description: An insatiable bloodthirst possessed Leonel Frisk since he first caught its scent. His sanguine dreams and hunger for violence brought him to the Bayou, where he searches for new prey, and fresh blood to spill.

name: Lulu
description: Though she preferred the fairer sex, Lulu Bassett got by taking men to her bed. When she learned that she could make a better living taking men to their graves, she decided to put her charms and instincts to use in the Hunt.

name: Luna Wolf
description: A merciless wolf hunter, Felicia Frisk came to Louisiana following her son´s footsteps, where she sought closure - but she only found the moonlight turned crimson with blood, and a mournful howl echoing in the Bayou.

name: Luz Mala
description: The ghost in the glow, Luz Mala was saved by the bad lights that flickered on the plains of Patagonia. Everything she knew destroyed, those same lights guided her towards her fate. Now, she is the damnation of those who are tempted to stray towards the light.

name: Mama Maye
description: Legends say that if you go to the greenhouse outside of Lawson, you´ll catch a glimpse of her: a haunted figure drifting around tending to the flowers and plants. But don´t let her catch you, otherwise you might end up as food for her flora.

name: Marian Lee
description: Marian Lee comes from the New York branch of the fallen AHA , originally an informer for Elwood Finch . When the organization died and Finch eventually disappeared, she took the opportunity to move to the other side of the desk, killing monsters instead of traitors.

name: Marrow Hawk
description: Originally a trapper from a poor town down south, Marrow Hawk became enamored with Skull Taker’s prowess when he passed through on a hunt. Her apprenticeship was brief, however; while he preferred his game live, she favored dismantling the dead.

name: Marshall Brewer
description: Phoebe Brewer, the first Louisianan woman to become a US Marshall, renounced a lifetime's work to fight the evil spreading in the bayou. It lost her an eye, her sobriety, and her public image, but her unknown legacy of fighting evil at its strongest was a price worth paying.

name: Mercy Zener: Rookie
description: Mercy Zener discovered her first Trace while hiding from a pack of agitated Hellhounds that nearly bled her out. The inoculation in her veins warmed as the corrupted indicator bubbled to life, lazily pointing towards a mysterious, prized destination. Mercy followed without question.

name: Mercy Zener: Survivor
description: When Mercy Zener discovered the formidable beast known as Rotjaw at the place where the Traces led, her heartbeat quickened at the opportunity for a quick bounty. But she underestimated Rotjaw, ultimately taking a bolt of arc bloom directly to her eye, permanently blinding it.

name: Mercy Zener: Veteran
description: Hunters who know Mercy Zener claim that the arc bloom injury changed her, made her bite at the moon and stuff her kills with mud and teeth. Did the Corruption leak into the open spaces of her mind, or was she sinister from the start?

name: Monroe
description: Henry Monroe is the sole survivor of the asylum massacre in Jackson. The horrors he witnessed in that nightmarish place left him changed beyond recognition – and reluctantly committed to survive by any means necessary. Still, the monsters of the Bayou are a trifle compared to what he experienced at Huff 's hands.

name: Montresor
description: Abandoned and left to die by his old hunting partner, Edward Montresor embraced the spirit of the old carnivals of Venice to enact a literary-inspired revenge. Now, his mysterious facade allows him to blend into Corruption's chaos, free to enact his every darket whim.

name: Mountie
description: Brought unwittingly into the secret war of the Hunt, Jeffrey Forsyth was forced to leave his old life as an enforcer of the law behind and take up a new, higher calling.

name: North Star
description: Student of mythology and master of the Five Forms, Chen Lan came to America to gain knowledge that might aid the fight on her home turf. Though silent about her journey from the Fujian province to New Orleans, her skill with a gun and fondness for violence speaks volumes about the red trail she cut from east to west.

name: Ochenkov's Widow
description: When Mary Ochenkov lost her beloved Petr at her own hands, the guilt destroyed her will to live. Mr. Chary used the shell she became to create something terrific, and from deep in Kingsnake Mine came the desperate screams of something terrifying and new.

name: Oliver Whitman: Rookie
description: As a new Hunter, Oliver Whitman didn’t know what to expect other than money. He typically followed the sound of gunshots to determine his routes and preferred to find his Bounty Tokens on the corpses of enemy Hunters. Before long, though, he yearned for more.

name: Oliver Whitman: Survivor
description: Grizzled by time and the witnessing of too many brutal deaths, Oliver Whitman eventually delved deeper into the darker shadows of the gulch, looking for something worth dying for. What he found in an abandoned basement just northeast of East Mountain Corn changed everything.

name: Oliver Whitman: Veteran
description: Oliver Whitman doesn’t remember much from before he discovered the cabin’s basement of sacred secrets. Emboldened by the warm embrace of a coat made of tanned rat hides, he now hunts with the twisted spirit of a man haunted, transformed by Corruption’s workings.

name: One Who Flies
description: Army scout One Who Flies–or Bemised, to his nation–returned to action to investigation strange happenings down south. After a suspicious inoculation, his bleak determination became a brutal nihilism so reckless that the stories reached farther than his reports.

name: Otis Blackwell
description: An experienced Hunter, Otis is Louisiana born and bred. A former soldier turned bounty hunter, he joined the Hunt in the early days and quickly acquired a reputation for lethality and surgical precision. He’s a man of few words and lets his guns do the talking for him.

name: Otis Blackwell: Warhorse
description: When the military came to fight Corruption, Otis re-enlisted, hoping more hands would make less work. Though bridges burned, he was crafty enough to survive the chaos. Now he aims to reconcile with Hunters who chose other sides.
source: The Regiment's Last Stand Story Challenge

name: Pappy Redneck
description: Rumor has it that Vernon Moses sat in the same rocking chair for thirty years with nothing on his tongue but moonshine and curses. But the false rumors have nothing on this staunch patriarch, who’s collected more bounties than you and your momma combined.

name: Perchta: Dawn
description: The myths of midwinter recall a time of reckoning: gifts for the good, retribution for the bad. The reckoners, few and far between, have been softened by time. But not Perchta, from ancient alpine valleys, where punishments are dealt with a blade at dusk, and trees gifted with rotten garlands at dawn.

name: Perchta: Dusk
description: In midwinter, the days are short, and it is the dusk and dark that rules over the dawn and light. Perchta only grows more feverous as the days shorten, for in the dark her truest form takes hold, and the light cowers from her fury.

name: Plague Doctor
description: The Plague Doctor, it's rumored, lost his mind fighting a resurgence of the Black Plague. Rage drove him to masks, ambergris, and laudanum, then to cabalistic ritual and macabre science. Convinced New Orleans represented a new evolution of the plague, he treated it with fire, lead, and his own array of ministrations.

name: Plains Warden
description: In a land where myths were culled, carved, and left to fester in skull piles, Plains Warden made an oath: To become nature’s arrow. To pierce the damned who hold nothing but rot and oil in their hearts. To remember the herds that roam no more.

name: Post Malone: Deposed King
description: With the circus falling under the HelioStone’s control, Post Malone knew his options were limited. He chose to run and fight another day, trailing the circus to follow wherever it goes. He travels incognito, but his goal remains the same: Take back what was his.

name: Post Malone: Ringmaster
description: As Ringmaster of the pre-Corrupted circus, Post Malone guided clowns and unleashed beasts. Bears beat on drums at the snap of his fingers. Anything could be turned into magic under his gaze, but such power is what death and Corruption crave from the shadows.

name: Private Eye
description: Candice Rouille left New York with her badge, her mentor, and an unbreakable will to uncover the truth in Louisiana. All three would be taken from her, and rather than leave the Bayou alone, she forged a new path of blood and bone.

name: Prudence Stallworth
description: Prudence Stallworth was setting up an ambush when a flash flood swept her downriver into a nest of Water Devils . Her enemies arrogantly assumed that she’d never escape. It was a mistake that worked in her favor when she reappeared, dripping, and cut their throats.

name: Rangda's Shadow
description: Once another faceless Hunter in the crowd, Rangda’s Shadow ascended into greater darkness via the transformation brought on by wearing her sacred mask. She strives to honor evil’s role in its endless dance with good—a dance that was never meant to end.

name: Red Raven
description: Red Raven joined the army with her cousin. She’d always removed enemies’ eyes if they refused to truly see her, but an experimental inoculation from The Cook made her knife dig deeper, slower. Her reports back to her outfit become incoherent rambles about a blood-soaked sky.

name: Redneck
description: William Moses, proud proprietor of Moses Poultry, is anything but chicken. Hunters first found him holed up in his farm , armed to the teeth. He joined their ranks then and there, having resisted the Sculptor for a record time. It’s disputed whether that’s due to his sheer stupidity or his sheer stubbornness.

name: Redshirt
description: After having drunk too much whiskey one night, Jonathan Redshirt accepted a bet from his companions: to enter the Bayou with a target on his back. If he made it out alive, the bet went, he'd be given the deeds to some land out West. Daredevil or fool? Only his tombstone will tell.

name: Ricky Leeds
description: Before the incursion, Ricky Leeds helped to maintain the cannons at Fort Carmick . After that job was nothing more than a memory eaten by Grunts , he worked hard to set up a shooting range where Hunters could test their equipment–on monsters and each other.

name: Sascha Romanov
description: Originally a reporter from the New Orleans True Crescent, Sascha Romanov came to the bayou with the intention of learning the truth. When she discovered the evil brewing in the swamplands would never be believed on paper, she traded her journalistic ambitions for a gun.

name: Scaramuccia
description: Theater twisted this proud performer into a freak show. Now, after a bloody emancipation, he feels at home amidst the monsters of the Bayou, where he can kill for coin instead of begging and pleading for it with a song and a dance.

name: Scourge: Midian
description: Midian always knew his pain was meaningless. “Abomination” he was called, so an abomination he became–one that thrived, and one that wielded might. Scrapbeak had shown this path, and he knew that betrayal lay at its end.

name: Scourge: Morrigan
description: Morrigan finally knew herself from the moment her reflection stared back from the Beak’s eyes. The wealth and riches she sought could be hers – power could be hers. No more hunger, pain, or seclusion, not if she was willing to take, keep, and bleed.

name: Sea Wolf
description: The time of the Viking is ancient history, filled with myth. Sea Wolf knew the power of those myths, so he used them to make himself and his sister into legends. For glory, gold, and pleasure does he massacre men and monsters.

name: Servant of the Void
description: Hailing from unknown lands and speaking dark prophecies, Betsy Rohrveldt carries with her the promise of an apocalyptic future. Eager to preach her words of destruction, she unleashes murderous fury on those who mock her tales of things from beyond space and time.

name: Sgt. Bridgewater
description: The injustice of war caused Sergeant Caleb Bridgewater to seek a different fight when word from home reached him of what was happening in the Bayou. Forced to desert, he's proud now to fight the only war he believes in.

name: Sgt. Riggins
description: Sergeant Riggins was loyal as they come until he saw his commander crack under pressure. His desperation for order became superstition, then occultism. He believes the military has much to learn, if they’re hungry enough.

name: Shade: Drifter
description: Jefferson Shiloh made his name playing the stalwart hero on stage, but he made precious little coin. When the Infection claimed his crewmates, he exchanged props for guns and brought his stage persona to life on the Hunt, where it finally earned a killing.

name: Shade: High Noon
description: Stage actor Jefferson Shiloh had one role above all others that he relished performing: a gunslinger, betrayed, slain, and resurrected to court vengeance. Once he turned his sights to the Corruption, Shiloh brought that role to life, turning the legend into a far grislier truth.

name: Sheriff Hardin
description: During the early days of the infection, Sheriff Wayne Hardin was instrumental in halting the rapid spread of the infection. However, the inmates he recruited to be Hunters proved unreliable, and as events spiraled out of control, he found himself putting many of them back under arrest.

name: Silver Spur
description: A walking dead man they call Silver Spur, Ezekiel Stringfellow has hunted his fellow man all his life. Cursed by illness to wander, he followed a vision to the Hunt, where his keen eye and steady hand have made him a formidable foe.

name: Skull Taker
description: Skull Taker is fueled by a primal pride. The trophies in his collection were all taken while his prey still drew breath. The runes carved into his mask are meant to draw the most savage and feral game to his hunting grounds.

name: Sofia
description: Visions forged by agony and suffering came true when Sofia’s family were murdered by four strangers. Blinded by an insatiable thirst for vengeance, she made a blood pact with Death and is now in pursuit to herald the Four’s last breaths.

name: Steel Eyed
description: Dust settles on the graves of the unwary, and the trail will eventually lead you to your death. This is the mantra of Red Descot, who murmured it through mountain passes, dry gullies, and blasted prairies. It was a lonesome journey until he was called to the Hunt, where his grit and anguish serve a much higher purpose.

name: Stormseer
description: A tarot card featuring a tower led Shana Barmont into the heart of a banishment storm. While she fled with The Turncoat and a satchel of bounties, unnatural lightning struck her. It fused an omen to her flesh, cursing her to enact the storm’s will.

name: Sunshine
description: A devastating betrayal took Evelyn "Sunshine" Darling to dark places, but true to her nickname, she would find light in the darkness in the form of a deadly new troupe of allies, determined to destroy the Corrupted Circus and hopeful for a new start.

name: Teche Wraith
description: Unwilling to relocate from their tribal lands, François Broussard's family fled to the margins of the swamplands, scaring trespassers off with eerie skill, stealth, and visage. Having thrived in a habitat shunned for its in-hospitability, the family became Hunters by necessity – and successes by merciless practice.

name: Tennessee Morgan: Rookie
description: Mild mannered Mr. Morgan was a bank clerk when he shot a robber in a moment of fight or flight. The kill awoke something insatiable in his soul, so he headed to Louisiana to explore it, finding dark salvation in the form of a Hunter's initiation.

name: Tennessee Morgan: Survivor
description: The more he killed, the more Tennessee Morgan came to believe that he'd found his true calling within the merciless darkness of the Incursion. He was free to take as many lives as he wanted - including any who criticized his brutal methods.

name: Tennessee Morgan: Veteran
description: Tennessee Morgan may have lost everything he once hold dear, but priorities change, especially admist the bloody hunger of the Hunt. Now, he embraces his gore with relish, silently blessing the robber who started it all after each and every kill.

name: Thaddeus Sumner
description: War never ends for Thaddeus Sumner. He works just as tirelessly against enemies who are already dead as he once did against the soldiers from the other side. The brutality and hopelessness are the same, but at least he sleeps better after killing monsters.

name: The Archaeologist
description: Drifting through the desert, a dream came to The Archaeologist: two children tumbling into black water. Recognizing the image’s importance, she followed it, like so many others, into the bayou.

name: The Bandit
description: Hungry for wealth, fame, and glory, the gang called the Blackhand Bandits were notorious–until the day when the money went missing and guns were pointed. Only one walked away from the bloodbath: The Bandit. Once he’d spent the blood-money, he joined the Turncoat Gang for more.

name: The Banished
description: There was a point in time when The Banished wondered if she’d ever feel a sense of belonging again. She never would have guessed that the hell she found would provide her with a place where she was both needed and feared.

name: The Beast Hunter
description: Snarling, bloody, gnashing teeth haunted Theodore Tuck’s nightmares, until he came face-to-face with their source in Louisiana. Tuck proved his mettle hunting the Bayou’s hellhounds – and his reckless focus when he attempted to train them to fight by his side.

name: The Beekeeper
description: Third in a generational line of apiarists, but the first to develop forbidden, esoteric practices. Her devoted mania saved her brood from the tar seeping into their nectar, but no known witchcraft can reclaim a daughter’s lost love.

name: The Black Coat
description: William Durant is a Hunter, a scoundrel, and a murderer with a complicated past. Loyal solely to himself and lacking even a shred of honor, when his friends meet, his moniker is only spat out alongside promises of vengeance.

name: The Bone Doctor
description: Born in Senegal and brought to New Orleans as a slave, Doctor John was eventually freed and rose to prominence in the New Orleans Voodoo community, leading a chapter of loyal Hunters. His abilities led to suspicions that he had caused the very plague he fought, though none who spoke against him survived for long.

name: The Bone Mason
description: Béatrice Maunet lost her light and name in the bone-lined halls of the Catacombs of Paris after finding her boy’s decomposing remains there. She crossed the Atlantic to Louisiana, hoping to absolve herself from remorse and hear her son’s voice again.
source: The Phantom of the Catacombs DLC

name: The Centipede
description: Burying the human that was born, something burrowed out from the soil. Not an apparition, nor an imitation, but a barbed and malevolent new avatar of Corruption. But her path was not a straight one, for a more Primal metamorphosis awaited her.

name: The Concubine
description: As Alaz's reputation grew, her past became a bloody fairytale, her present soaked in blood and mud. She chases a future molded by hatred and vengeance; a future she promised to herself and her lost sisters.

name: The Conspirator
description: The flames of November 5th taught the self-proclaimed heir of the Gunpowder Plot not to speak out against unjust rule, but the fires of war taught him silence was untenable. Taking up his forefather’s crusade, The Conspirator reforges himself in the furnace of the bayou.

name: The Cook
description: Griz Levenson used to cook with a sound and passionate mind until the traumas of war and the insanity of the Incursion changed him into something new. Now he is ruled by a variety of insatiable, unspeakable cravings, all of which influence his deadly recipes.

name: The Cowl
description: The Cowl made his mark by learning how to thrust his blade in just the right place to create the most chaos. But the Assassin 's swarms showed him a new way with no leaders, only followers. Now he seeks to supplant the Target and become a truer instrument of the Corruption.
source: The Shadow Under the Cowl DLC

name: The Drowned Kid
description: Once a troublemaker with everything to prove, The Drowned Kid was murdered and reforged with the debris of a thousand shipwrecks. His mind is as frantic as all drowning men’s, and he's set on not only proving his worth, but punishing those who refuse to acknowledge it.

name: The Drowned Rat
description: Lifeless and decaying, the Rat sank forever. At forever's end, a ritual was performed: the hearts of a hundred sailors set aflame. Incantations uttered to rot flesh in reverse. She awoke cursed with a mind fractured between worlds, charged with saving only one of them.

name: The Empress
description: A love of arachnids drove Emelia B. Bryant to become a Hunter. After being kidnapped and ritually gutted, that love saved her. She awoke with her wounds woven shut by spiders. Now devoted to their webs, The Empress believes herself to be the Bileweavers’ mother.

name: The Exile
description: Delphine Terrebonne grew up in the heat of her grandfather's rage at his tribe's displacement from Louisiana. An artist with leather, bone, and shell, Delphine returned to her ancestral home to find work, instead finding a corruption against which she vowed to fight with axe, blade, and bow.

name: The Fang Shearer
description: Alligators on the rim of the bayou were found mutilated, with runes carved into their spines and teeth. The Fang Shearer gathered these remnants, charted their inscriptions against the stars. He now hunts the legend they foretold, yearning still to know its meaning.

name: The Fool: Fugitive
description: For Doc Redmartin, the road to pell is paved with smiles. His “Miracle Mouth All-Cure” was meant to stop the plague. Instead, The Spirited exposed that it only spread lunacy, twisting the lips of countless innocents. In return, they carved Redmartin’s mouth forever wide.

name: The Fool: Outlaw
description: Doc Redmartin faced execution, but the Pale Judge drew The Fool card and set him loose after affixing a punishing mask. Redmartin boarded trains, left passengers laughing–even as they jumped through the windows. He’s a joke with no end. Nothing can catch him.

name: The Foxhound
description: When Jesper Hayes sought out a pair of legendary trappers , he learned that even nature keeps secrets. Now, he works with that damned knowledge to harness not just the power of mother nature, but the nightmarish condition that seems to have befallen her.

name: The Gunslinger
description: The century closed in around the wild west, taming it beyond recognition. The frontier on which the lawless gunslinger May Belle cut her teeth shrank, and her former accomplices turned against her. In the Bayou she found a new home, but her past always threatened to catch up – until one day it did.

name: The Hanged Man
description: Nine times the noose pulled tight. Nine times he survived. Each failed hanging bestowed a vision upon The Hanged Man: witches and gardens . Tents and trials . The drawing of an ominous tarot card which indicated the rise of a great and terrible Empress .

name: The Headsman
description: We fear what we cannot see, and hide from what horrors we do. Face serrated by scars, hands calloused by the swing of the axe, and mind warped by violence both witnessed and committed, The Headsman donned the executioner's robe and hood both to terrify and to hide.

name: The Highwayman
description: Wit Ottaway has distant memories of an honest life. He made his name as a highwayman, until he robbed someone he shouldn’t have and learned something he couldn’t forget. This mistake chased him until The Turncoat gunned it down, and now he repays him with a life debt.

name: The Hornback
description: Prideful to a fault, Marsha Colm–the Hornback–ingratiated herself to The Reptilian , turning hard won hides into precious dollars. Her flair for dress was balanced with ruthlessness, granting her success with certain clientele - and uses far beyond stitching.

name: The Hyena
description: Harlan Grant and his hyena Cackle were inseparable, stars of The Murder Circus. But when the HelioStone arrived, it Corrupted Cackle and Grant had to put his friend down. Now he fights alone against the HelioStone’s minions, carrying the memory of Cackle with him always.

name: The Infected
description: Most Exposed to the Bayou's corruption turn mercifully quickly, while an unlucky few live to witness their own slow demise. Some succumb to insanity and festering sores, while other - one such Bennett Hudson - suffer a necrosis that spreads like gangrene and offers no comfort in death.

name: The Ironclad
description: Hailing from the chaotic badlands of old Australia, The Ironclad was laying low in the years since his alleged death. But when he discovered what was happening in Louisiana, he knew it was time to don his old armor once again.

name: The Kid
description: Turner Abaddon, Jr. was the youngest of eight: a runt with a chip on his shoulder, and everything to prove. Quick to pick a fight, and just as quick to run off - until his skill with dual pistols earned him his place among the Hunters.

name: The Mercenary
description: As the 26th Regiment slowly realized they'd overestimated their own abilities, it was Miriam Conly who tried to warn her commander against Corruption's manipulation. But his paranoia turned against her, and she was forced to flee for her life, going rogue in the Hunt.

name: The Miko
description: The Miko tended her family’s shrine long after it fell to ruin. Even when destroyed, the ringing of its bell never ceased. She followed its melody to Louisiana where she aims her bow to strike the thousand mouths that give it a voice.

name: The Moorhound
description: Jacob Arawn set out to slay the Black Dog of Hell, but has become a figure near synonymous with the hound he hunted. Now he continues his crusade, with decades of surviving harsh lands and eyes that have seen indescribable terrors, turning him into a mythical foe.

name: The Mountain Man
description: Thomas Bridge was one of many Mountain Men to open up the American frontier. He turned his back on civilization after escaping a burning mill besieged by five hundred insurrectionists. Ever since, he can only sleep under a night sky, and he counts trapping, scouting, and bounty hunting as his trades.

name: The Night Acolyte
description: Nadia Orville is a member of doomsday cult, Night of the Hunter, and founder Isaac Powell 's right-hand fighter. An orphan with nothing to lose, she's a brute in a fight, made all the more frightening by the occult symbols drawn on her clothing in the blood of her victims.

name: The Night Mother
description: An expert rootworker with a knack for conjuring, Esther Sinclaire sought out the inoculation to stand by her dear Weird Sister ’s side. She seeks forbidden, otherworldly knowledge through the bounty hunt, assisting her seasoned partner as they face unspeakable evils together.

name: The Night Seer
description: Originally initiated into the Hunt by a small group of militiamen, Isaac Powell was changed by a vision of the impending end of the world and Second Coming. He founded Night of the Hunter, a Blood Cult whose members believe the blood of the creatures they hunt is holy, and adorn themselves with it in the belief that it will save them from death in this world, and buy themselves redemption in the next.

name: The Ol' Cowpoke
description: Imagine Dusty Ivo’s shock when he discovered the Corruption after checking on some beloved horses he’d sold to Davant Ranch. Now it’s time for him to get some rootin’ tootin’ revenge against the whippersnappers keen on silencing horses to save their own hides.

name: The Pale Judge
description: Moby Winneford’s judgement failed him only once. He ignored a fortune teller, and the released bandit slaughtered his daughter. Now he is fate’s gavel, his justice drawn from that same fortune teller’s tarot. Only a card can set someone free–or sentence them to hang.

name: The Penitent
description: Damien Yedaiah buried his past beneath his countless scars, pain helping him to silence his demons. But as his body collapsed and his mind gave way, he found salvation in the blood and pain of others.

name: The Phantom
description: Gus Leroux: A former lawyer with a penchant for violence, this theatrical Hunter covers his scarred visage with a mask - not because he is ashamed of the injuries beneath, but because it terrifies his opponents.

name: The Prescient
description: Never blind to life’s injustices, Ira Ozols trod a dark path towards powers that would let her glimpse what was to come. To make judgements based on the past, and the future. On realizing her goal, she lost sight of the present, but became renowned for her prescience.

name: The Prodigal Daughter
description: Stories about her mother’s heroism as a Union spy in the Civil War were Sarah Burton’s only inheritance. Burton donned her mother's uniform, setting out to live up to that example and avenge the cruel circumstances of her mother’s death. In the Bayou, Burton found what she sought - her only chance for atonement.

name: The Prodigal Son
description: The Prodigal Son knows there's a bullet out there with his name on it—he just prefers to keep it close. While others fear being brought to reckoning, he welcomes it; any chance to make amends for a life of misdeeds.

name: The Rat
description: There are two kinds of people in the world: those living on the right side of the law, and those living on the wrong. Tona Ramirez was the second kind from birth, and when she buried her father in an unmarked grave on the border, she inherited both his nickname and the story of a man robbed of fortune.

name: The Reaper
description: Claeg Grey's memory was leaving him. As his mind drifted and became blank, there was one thing that brought him back: Taking someone's life. Desperate to keep him alive, Claeg's family sent him to DeSalle where he could freely reap death.

name: The Redneck's Daughter
description: Born in a barn and madder than a wet hen ever since, Millie Moses always wanted to be like her dear ol’ daddy, fighting Corruption to protect their family farm. Now, she’s old enough to join the fun… and she’s got some serious bones to pick.

name: The Reptilian
description: When the alligators fled the Bayou, desperation and greed turned former-gator hunter Keith Cowen's mind, the skin of his coat a testament to his persistence, his skill, and his treachery.

name: The Researcher
description: Harold Black’s journal—a collection of anatomical sketches and scientific observations—constitutes most of what Hunters know about their enemy. His hodgepodge education, acquired on many walks of life, gave him the ability to see connections no one else could, and see reason where others only saw madness.

name: The Revenant
description: John Robertson wanted to be remarkable; to either be a hero or die as one. He failed at both, shot through the heart during a poker game. He was the first in the bayou to find himself at a crossroads, and one of the few who chose the road back to life, guided by the chanting of the Night Speaker.

name: The Reverend
description: As a young man, Reverend Ishim Gird came to the bayou to save the souls of the innocents. As the infection took hold, he witnessed his congregation tear each other apart in Stillwater Bayou . Barely escaping with his life, he vowed to rid the swamp of it's denizens.

name: The Ronin
description: Inuta Bakin had barely sworn his oath of allegiance when the Tokugawa shogunate was disposed. Without a master, he wandered further than most Ronin, seeking the power to take revenge. A traditionalist, he dresses and fights in centuries-old styles, and his leering Oni mask has been the last sight of many on the Hunt.

name: The Royal Phantom
description: Gus Leroux’s transformation from lawyer to The Phantom was as unexpected as the loss of his arm. Eventually the Phantom persona took over completely, crafting a new foundation from which he could rise. Now, he brings deadly justice with a wealth of earned experience.

name: The Scaled Ward
description: The Scaled Ward was wary of his mentor –he knew his gravest sin, but would bide his time to repeat it. Yet when The Reptilian went on, he would follow his trail, all toward the greatest sin yet.

name: The Scaled Warrior
description: The student has become the teacher. Once the apprentice to the renowned Reptilian , The Scaled Warrior proved himself worthy of taking up his mentor’s mantle when he beat him to first killing Rotjaw . Strong, but not a fool, he still follows the old man’s wisdom.

name: The Scarecrow
description: Caught stealing from Golden Acres , Jeremy Albano was beaten, stuffed into a scarecrow's outfit, and left bound in the field – where he witnessed his assailants become painstakingly Corrupted, ripping each other to shreds. Believing it unholy justice, Albano vowed himself to the Sculptor’s will.

name: The Sharpshooter
description: Though recruited by Sunshine , Grace Kim quickly defected from the troupe to become The Disciple of Death’s right trigger hand. Technical and precise, her marksmanship and elegance made her an excellent performer–and sworn enemy of Desert Rose .
source: Post Malone's Murder Circus Encore Event

name: The Shroud
description: Shame, sickness, and undeath plagued Nafisa Elhami for digging up Pharaohs of old and leading foreigners to their treasure. She followed those foreigners to the Hunt, where numbness is her curse and her only reprieve is granting others the death she craves.

name: The Skinflint
description: One dreary winter's night, Timothy Stone bore witness to three strange apparitions, each bearing portents of his past, present, and future. Whether real or imagined, the experience convinced Stone to inoculate himself and join the Hunt, where he would become known for being slow to his wallet but quick to his rifle.

name: The Skinned
description: The son of Frank Gravel, Killian vowed vengeance on his murderer, The Reptilian . He took up his father's mantle and pursued his quarry to dark shores-where they found a prize big enough to put the past to rest.

name: The Skinner
description: The Skinner suffered a lot of pain, but in his quest for vengeance he found himself turning the knife. It wasn’t until The Reptilian was at his mercy that the lure of riches became stronger than the pull of revenge. Now, they hunt together.

name: The Sovereign
description: A strategist and sniper of otherworldly skill, Xiao Feng left the Fujian province with his hunting partner, Chen Lan, crossing the globe in a constant sweep of bloody encounters. Rumors of the duo’s deadly skill preceded their arrival in New Orleans, and they were welcomed with reverence befitting the highest nobility.

name: The Spinning Blade
description: A knife thrower’s assistant, Amelie Rimrose snapped after years of abusive treatment at his hands. For her new act, she strapped her boss to the board and demonstrated her skills, awakening a taste for blood that only hunting bigger and fiercer game could sate.

name: The Spirited
description: Behind the saloon counter, Eddie Davies learned to read people as clearly as a bottle label. Left without patrons to serve and a thirst to beat impossible odds, he's betting on boldness and guile to make it through the Bayou.

name: The Statesman
description: Anonymity serves many purposes, but some ambitions require a forceful hand. Emerging from the clouds of statecraft, the Statesman claims Tokens for the masters he serves, spreading their will amongst Hunters far and wide.

name: The Strongman
description: Bradley the Brutal cut his teeth–and many throats–underground boxing in England. He joined Sunshine’s troupe because he dreamed of something bigger. Bigger fights. Bigger audiences. Bigger rewards. His violent outbursts and temper make him a formidable and unpredictable opponent.
source: Post Malone's Murder Circus Encore Event

name: The Third Brother
description: The Incursion zones carry endless pieces of dark knowledge which catch the attention of The Third Brother, whose past as a librarian only nurtures his morbid curiosity over the Sculptor and its many twisted creations.

name: The Third Son
description: The third son of a third son of a third son, Nahotabi was endowed with notable strength, a brazen manner, and preternatural skill in hand-to-hand combat. By day, a dedicated, curious, and quiet librarian; by night, a silent and deadly terror with pistol or blade.

name: The Turncoat
description: Wim Jansen went west to bleed the land dry, but in the end was victim to the frontier's relentless brutality. Falsely labeled a turncoat after his regiment's ambush, he wears the title proudly now, captivated by the meridian of blood, mind set only on violence and revenge.

name: The Viper: Frenzy
description: The Viper uncovered secrets no mortal should know, and instead of succumbing to madness, rose anew. No longer relegated to the shadows, they now follow their own whim. With boundless power and new-found purpose, the Viper stepped further into the Bayou.

name: The Viper: Onset
description: A body count nearing the hundreds, yet no inkling of a name, face, or even gender. Westerners call this Persian assassin "Viper", for they’re silent and cunning like the slithering creature, with a poisonous signature move. When they sparked Chary’s interest, their life was bound – or doomed – to change irrevocably.

name: The Viper: Rise
description: The Sinners offered money and favors, but what persuaded the Viper to heed Chary's call was his unwavering promise that their snake Delara would thrive as a result. The Serpent Moon gave Delara renewed strength and the Viper a foreign feeling of hope.

name: The Viper: Surge
description: When the dust settled, the work was done: Delara was safe. The Viper cut allegiance to the man who had risked their lives and tried to move on, but the sting of betrayal remained sharp, driving them to fight – for once, of their own volition.

name: The Waldmann
description: A village of fifty-five set out to slay a mythical doe: ten feet tall with pure white antlers. All returned empty-handed, for a stranger– The Waldmann – carried the prize. He now wears the antlers on his back wherever he goes, for the red stains are not of deer’s blood.

name: The Wayfarer
description: The Wayfarer rode to Louisiana to face the monsters there, earning her keep along the way. Her tales of exploit and adventure have earned her acclaim, but what few know is that every word is true.

name: The Waymaker
description: The experience of navigating her way through the infected bayou changed the way The Waymaker tracks and kills. Whenever she thinks she’s seen it all, the Corruption finds a terrifying new way to surprise her.

name: The Witch Hunter
description: Descended from a long line of witch hunters, Circe Elias was raised ready to fight the unknown. When word got to the New York branch of the AHA about Louisiana, Circe knew she needed to go put her lineage and training to work.

name: Thirteenth Mate
description: Thirteen ships sailed, thirteen ships drowned, and thirteen times this sailor has returned from the depths. On that thirteenth ship he threw himself overboard with his crewmates, only to rise again, their voices wailing eternally. He walks without sleeping, seeking both revenge and death.

name: Thorn Wreath
description: A tainted scion of frost touched by Corruption, Thorn Wreath now serves all who cross her with a brutal bite of deadly cold. She twists the ceremonies of midwinter into malignant versions of themselves, and mistletoe left for Hunters means death’s kiss is near.

name: Tonya Wegman
description: A seamstress who once designed pieces for Louisiana’s finest, Tonya Wegman can’t help but smile whenever she runs into her old modeling mannequins while hunting. Sometimes she even arranges them in eerie placements herself, hoping to spook potential enemies into letting their guard down.

name: Trapper: Buckshot
description: Robert Hogen, known as Buckshot, is a mountain man of unparalleled skill, he can trap any man or beast alive. Always taciturn, he allows his traps and his guns to do the talking for him. May heaven have mercy on anyone who tries to take from him, or those he holds close.

name: Trapper: Snare
description: A peerless survivalist and tracker, Laura Merrill, known as Snare, can follow the slightest clue to her prey. Merciless, she strikes swiftly with a raptor’s fury. Confident she can take down anything the wilderness throws at her, she is committed to survival in the face of the fiercest odds.

name: Umpire's Bane
description: The horrors of the bayou were no match for Umpire’s Bane, who faced the challenges of the Hunt like every contract was the championship game. The gruesome trophies that now lined his shelf were different than shining brass, but harder earned and more skillfully acquired.

name: Union Suit: Red Drawers
description: Dirty work requires dirtier attire. When carving up crows for stew, Kurtis. E. Falk dons these long johns to hide the stains. Legend has it he’s added a gallon of blood to the suit for every mile he crossed on his thousand-mile trek to Louisiana.

name: Union Suit: Sunday Best
description: While gruff in appearance, Union Suit’s voice can melt the wings of an angel. He often yodels at sunrise to an audience of Infected. His attempts to entrance Targets with ballads always fail, but he saves these once-white garments for his finest of vocal performances.

name: Vaquero
description: Brutally torn from his old life, Teddy Figueroa forged a new identity after a night of bloody vengeance in the Sonoran Desert. Now known only as Vaquero, he searches for the one man who escaped him, not caring who–or what–gets in his way.

name: Vinson Hayes
description: A stalwart fighter against strikebreakers across the Midwest, Vinson found himself the target of murderous attacks as a result. He shed his old life as a result and found himself in the bayou, where his particular set of skills could be put to good use.

name: Wayward Helmsman
description: The Wayward Helmsman has seen water in all its forms: Surging through coral. Sitting calm in flooded holds. Pouring in squalls over dead men at sea. When he arrived in Louisiana, he drowned his true name and replaced it with a lust for treasure.

name: Weird Sister
description: Inspired by the healing powers of Voodoo King Doctor John , Cora Beukes became a Voodoo practitioner and was initiated into John's inner circle of devout Hunters.

name: Welder: Flame
description: Hubert Brahm loved his craft–until working with too much tainted metal retrieved from the Incursion warped his brain. Now he seeks to incorporate Hunters, as well as metal, into his twisted creations to fight back against the Corruption-spawned visions that flood his mind.
source: 800 Blood Bonds / Garden of the Witch Event

name: Welder: Torch
description: Luther Brahm used to repair heavy machinery in lands that were ultimately swallowed by Corruption. When working safely became impossible, he found a purpose in hunting with his brother, but when Hubert went dangerously mad, he continued to protect him no matter the cost.
source: 800 Blood Bonds / Garden of the Witch Event

name: Wight Raven
description: Hulda Kronick had little interest in her brother ’s scheming, but she happily fulfilled her given role in pursuit of honor. Though she held deep respect for fellow warriors, often challenging other Hunters to duels, she was plagued by a far greater, less noble bloodlust.

name: Willa Thomas
description: Willa Thomas was working at Alain & Son's Fish when the Incursion first awoke in Louisiana. Some say she escaped unscathed after taking out waves of the dead with nothing more than the meat cleaver from her station.

name: Winky
description: A maestro of murder, this silent clown is proficient to an ungodly degree with all manner of firearms and thrown weapons. Reduced by the effects of the HelioStone to a single-minded killer, Winky gets the last laugh by cutting smiles into enemy throats.

name: Worm Bite
description: Worm Bite treads where maggots set their mouths to work in Stillwater Bayou . Each soul he buries is gifted a single bullet. One flash of light. One last chance to strike the darkness in the place it calls home.

name: Zachary Jones
description: No monster is too big for Zachary Jones. He claims to have once taken on twin Meatheads with nothing but an axe, a blindfold, and a belly full of liquor. Whenever insecure Hunters call his bluff with a gunfight, though, they always die regretting it.

name: Zhong Kui
description: Descendant of an ancient line of demon quellers, the man who now calls himself Zhong Kui is associated with the five bats, which represent the five fortunes: longevity, wealth, health, virtue, and peaceful death. Yet these are not a Hunter's fortunes. Only the curse - and blessing - of death await Zhong and his companion.

name: Zhuge Liu
description: Even in a secluded Taoist monastery in China, the call for Hunters was heard. Zhuge Liu was chosen to go forth into the world to fight unknown horrors. With her unique skills and knowledge of Incursions past, she brings a new element to the Hunt.
